title: Chicago 1930: playing with Louis Armstrong and Sherman Cook
summary: He played with Louis Armstrong in Chicago in 1930, no cutting contest, with Sherman Cook along; stories of a piano and of Lill being sick.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

Yeah, I played with him.
